method: Rendered every page of the three booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (listening 1-16, composing 1-16, elective 1-8) and read every ask page in full; confirmed listening 1, 7, 12-16, composing 1, 2, 12-16 and elective 1, 3-8 carry no ask. Zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 250-400 dpi on each question block and every glyph in doubt: THREE in the Q6 lead-in (the text layer stores "three", the page prints capitals) and in the Q1-Q5 lead-ins and Q6 excerpt bullets; the bullets of each lead-in (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q6 and the Q6 excerpt headings print bullets; Q5 A prints none; Q2/Q4 print one before "Answer the following questions:"); the bold excerpt headings ("Excerpt 1." with a full stop and sentence on listening p2; bare "Excerpt 1" with no full stop in Q5 A and Q6); the Q4 lyric block (chord G and superscript 7 of A⁷ above line 1, a 7pt span in the text layer; G above line 2; labels "1."-"7."; curly apostrophes in Pepper’s / They’ve / they’re / you’ve; the italic ’ of Sgt. Pepper’s; "Mc Cartney" printed with a space); the double space in Q4(iv) "of  this" (measured: two 3pt spaces); "tSugáin" (acute on the second a only); the superscript th of 20th in Q5 B(ii); en dashes in bars 1–6, 1–4, 5–10, 1–16, 1–8, lines 1–4, 1–7 and composing Q1 "16–bar" against the hyphen in Q3 "16-bar" and "3-note"; AA¹BB¹ with its closing full stop (two 6pt "1" spans); the drawn flat in "B♭ major" (OpusChords "Bb" in the text layer, a raised flat on the page); PREPARATORY WORK in regular-weight capitals; the stems "Answer ONE QUESTION ONLY in this section: Q1 or Q2 or Q3" / "Q4 or Q5 or Q6" (no closing full stop) and "Answer ALL questions.". Cross-checked words and fonts against the text-layer spans. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets as "\n• ", " • " between printed bullet lines, a space for unbulleted lines, "\n" between the two Q1 Excerpt 2(ii) lines either side of the printed options, tick boxes as "□ ", the Q5 B stem per the lane ruling) and compared each file string exactly with no normalisation, then listed the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings (¹ U+00B9, á U+00E1, é U+00E9, – U+2013, ’ U+2019, • U+2022, ⁷ U+2077, □ U+25A1, ♭ U+266D). The file has no readFromPage entries. Elective Q2-Q4(b) carry no grid (shared card led by Q1), so no grid.stem there.
